messages:
alex: Heads-up: I have a stacked PR set that needs coordinated merges across repos — SDK #412, API #980, Console #225. SDK depends on API change that renames param `max_batch` -> `batch_limit`. Need approvals + a merge order. Can we do this today before the merge window (EOD PST)?
priya: I can review API #980 now. Note: the change is backward-compatible if SDK toggles legacy flag, but runtime helm needs a config default bump. I'll run e2e after I merge.
jamie: Console #225 is just UI; it references new API field. I can hold off but will need a new API client version or the console will 500 on old API. We should publish SDK + bump version before deploying console.
marta: We have a small merge window at 16:00 PST. Ops prefers one repo at a time. Suggested order: API -> SDK -> Console. SDK release job will publish a tagged release which Console can consume. Who's available at 15:30 for quick rollback plan?
alex: Order sounds good. I can be on deck at 15:30. For SDK release: label `release/next` on merge to trigger release pipeline. Also SDK PR has failing lint on CI but only in python test; ci-bot shows flake8 error.
ci-bot: CI update: SDK #412 failed - pyflakes error in sdk/core/transport.py: line 43 unused import. API #980 passed lint but had one integration flake (timing). Console #225 checks passed.
priya: Fixing API integration flake, pushing amended commit in 10m. Alex — can you drop the legacy flag check into SDK so it's feature-flagged? That will allow console to keep using old behavior for a short warm-up.
alex: Yep will add feature flag `enable_batch_limit` default=false. Will push patch in ~8m. Also making the changelog note. PR will include this snippet: ```python
if flags.enable_batch_limit:
    payload['batch_limit'] = val
```
jamie: :thumbsup: once SDK publishes, Console will point at `@redwood/sdk@v1.12.0` in package.json. I'll open a quick PR to update package.json and helm chart values (image tag + feature flag env).
ryan: Do we want a canary deploy to a subset of traffic? I can configure routing to route 5% to new API variant after SDK and Console are live. Need an explicit timestamp for rollout.
marta: Let's do a phased rollout starting 16:30 PST + monitor for 30m. If any errors >1% cancel. @ryan will set canary; @priya — ensure logs include batch param metrics.
priya: I'll add logs and a metric `batch_limit_received` in API. Also tagging the API release with `rollout: canary-ready`.
alex: Patch pushed and CI green now. SDK CI shows release job queued. Am requesting reviewers: @marta for merge policy, @jamie for console compatibility. SDK PR: https://github.com/redwood/sdk/pull/412
jamie: Reviewing SDK now. Quick Q: does the feature flag default to false in env var too? If so we can land Console PR after SDK tag.
alex: Yes, env var: REDWOOD_ENABLE_BATCH_LIMIT=false by default. Will include migration note in PR body.
marta: I’ll be online at 15:20 to coordinate. If all good we'll do API at 15:50, SDK at 16:05, Console at 16:20. Post-merge run smoke tests: /scripts/smoke.sh --suite=prod-lite
ryan: I'll set traffic switch for 16:30 and watch + alert on error spikes.
jamie: LGTM from me on Console PR once SDK tag available. :white_check_mark: 
priya: API merged at 15:54 (980). Logs enabled. Pushed tag v2.3.1-canary.
ci-bot: SDK release job completed: published @redwood/sdk v1.12.0. SDK #412 merged by alex at 16:06.
alex: Merged SDK, tagging release branch. Opening Console PR update to use v1.12.0 now.
jamie: Console PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/console/pull/225 — updates package and helm values. Triggering chart build.
ci-bot: Helm chart build passed. Deploy pipeline for console scheduled at 16:20.
ryan: Canary routing in place at 16:30, 5% traffic to canary. Monitoring dashboards up.
marta: Starting smoke tests now. If all pass, gradual increase to 50% at 17:00.
jamie: Smoke tests passed for console and sdk. No client errors in the first 15m.
priya: API saw 0.2% errors (expected transient). Keeping canary. Good to increase at 17:00.
alex: Thanks everyone! Will file post-merge note in #eng-release later. If anything spikes ping me or @ryan immediately.
